title: 第四章 什么天赋这么猛？！
novel_title: 全民原始部落，你搞军事基地？
content_zh:
翌日。

    经过一夜的休息，秦天感觉神清气爽。

    他翻身下床，刚刚走出茅草屋，一道冰冷的系统提示音便在所有人耳中同时响起。

    【提示：新手保护期剩余时间：48小时！】

    【提示：领地外围区域已开始刷新凶兽！】

    【提示：当前阶段凶兽不会主动攻击领地，但会主动袭击离开领地范围的生灵！】

    【提示：请各位领主尽快提升实力，否则新手保护期结束后，领地将随时面临兽潮冲击！】

    ……

    系统声音结束之后。

    整个世界频道瞬间炸了，所有人都陷入了混乱。

    【卧槽？凶兽刷新了？真的假的？】

    【我刚刚让两个领民出去砍树，结果差点被一头黑狼扑死！】

    【完了完了，我的天赋是种植类的，根本没有战斗力啊！】

    【系统说凶兽不会主动攻击领地，可现在除了有战斗能力的人谁还敢出去搜集资源啊？】

    恐慌的情绪顿时在所有人内心蔓延，毕竟不是所有人的天赋都和秦天一样逆天。

    不过在短暂的恐慌之后，不少领主都想到了抱团求生。

    【有没有人组队发育？我是E级侦查天赋，可以提前发现危险，求有战斗能力的大佬组队！】

    【求组队！我可以搜集稀有资源，但没有战斗能力，只要有人保护我安全，资源五五分！】

    【缺输出的速来！我是A级巨龙召唤，我倒是要看看什么凶兽能够打的过我的巨龙！】

    【卧槽，大佬求带！】

    ……

    一条条的消息不断刷屏。

    秦天目光平静的飞速扫过所有消息，内心却没有太大的波澜，更没有组队的想法。

    他早就猜到了会有人组队，毕竟在弱肉强食的世界里，弱者只能够抱团取暖。

    可任何事情都是两面性的，组队的风险就是防着凶兽的同时，还要防着队友在背后捅刀子。

    对他来说，只要自己在穿云狙击塔的射程范围内就应该不会有太大的安全问题。

    秦天直接关闭了嘈杂的世界频道。

    此刻领地内的二十名领民也都纷纷苏醒了。

    秦天扫过众人一圈，随即沉声道：“所有人继续出去搜集资源，重点收集木材和石材，搜索范围还是在三公里内。”
content_en:
The next day.

    After a night's rest, Qin Tian felt refreshed.

    He rolled out of bed, and as soon as he walked out of the thatched hut, a cold system prompt sounded in everyone's ears at the same time.

    [Tip: The remaining time of the novice protection period: 48 hours! 】

    [Tip: Ferocious beasts have begun to spawn in the outer areas of the territory! 】

    [Tip: At the current stage, ferocious beasts will not actively attack the territory, but will actively attack creatures that leave the territory! 】

    [Tip: All lords, please improve your strength as soon as possible, otherwise after the novice protection period ends, the territory will face the impact of the beast tide at any time! 】

    …

    After the system sound ends.

    The entire world channel exploded instantly, and everyone fell into chaos.

    【What the hell? The beast has been refreshed? Real or fake? 】

    [I just asked two of my neighbors to go out to chop down trees, but they were almost killed by a black wolf! 】

    [It’s over, it’s over, my talent is for planting, and I have no fighting power at all! 】

    [The system says that ferocious beasts will not take the initiative to attack the territory, but now who dares to go out to collect resources except those who are capable of fighting? 】

    Panic suddenly spread in everyone's hearts. After all, not everyone's talents are as incredible as Qin Tian's.

    However, after a brief period of panic, many lords thought of grouping together to survive.

    【Has anyone formed a team to develop? I have an E-level reconnaissance talent. I can detect danger in advance. I am looking for a team with some bosses who have the ability to fight! 】

    【Please form a team! I can collect rare resources, but I have no combat ability. As long as someone keeps me safe, the resources are 50/50! 】

    [If you are short of output, come quickly! I am an A-level dragon summoner, and I want to see what ferocious beast can beat my dragon! 】

    [Shit, boss, please take me with you! 】

    …

    Messages keep flooding the screen.

    Qin Tian's eyes calmly scanned all the news quickly, but he didn't have much turmoil in his heart, let alone the idea of ​​forming a team.

    He had already guessed that someone would form a team. After all, in a world where the jungle prevails, the weak can only stay together to stay warm.

    But everything has two sides. The risk of forming a team is to guard against vicious beasts and at the same time guard against teammates stabbing you in the back.

    For him, as long as he is within the range of the Cloud Penetrating Sniper Tower, there shouldn't be much of a safety problem.

    Qin Tian directly closed the noisy world channel.

    At this moment, the twenty citizens in the territory also woke up.

    Qin Tian glanced at everyone, and then said in a deep voice: "Everyone continues to go out to collect resources, focusing on collecting wood and stone. The search range is still within three kilometers."
title_en: Chapter 4 What talent is so powerful? !
